items.title: Ralph LaLama interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 23, 2010
items.q: I play a trio, Bop Juice, it’s a trio, with Clifford Barbaro, and the bass player du jour and me.

ctx.x: It’s on, you can get that on video live, right?

Oh yes, that’s right. I’m usually there, one Saturday every month, at 7:30, yeah. And I play a trio, Bop Juice, it’s a trio, with Clifford Barbaro, and the bass player du jour and me. So it’s Bop Juice.
